instruction: Use the terminal to add all files to staging, commit as 'project setup', and push to the main branch of the origin repository.

command: git config --global user.name "xlang" && git config --global user.email "xlang2024anonym@gmail.com" && mkdir -p /home/user/projects/remote_project && cd /home/user/projects/remote_project && git init --initial-branch=main && git config receive.denyCurrentBranch ignore
unzip -q /home/user/Downloads/binder.zip -d /home/user/projects/ && cd /home/user/projects/binder && git init --initial-branch main && git remote add origin /home/user/projects/remote_project

cd /home/user/projects/remote_project; git log --oneline | head -n 1 | awk '{for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) {printf "%s%s", $i, (i==NF ? "" : " ")}; print ""}'; remote_id=$(git log --oneline | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}'); cd /home/user/projects/binder; local_id=$(git log --oneline | head -n 1 | awk '{print $1}'); if [ "${local_id}" = "${remote_id}" ]; then echo "repo is synchronous"; else echo "repo is not synchronous"; fi; file_count=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "${file_count}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "files were staged and committed"; else echo "no files in commit"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding all files, committing with message 'project setup', and pushing to origin/main. Evaluator checks: 1) commit message contains 'project setup' 2) local and remote repos are synchronized 3) files were actually staged and committed (not empty commit). Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter. Verified by git workflow: the bash command extracts the commit message from remote repo, checks if local/remote commit IDs match, and verifies the commit contains files using git diff-tree.
